§6Apiary§f

§aBreed bees for honeycombs, waxcombs, and grubs.§f

Put a §bQueen Bee§f inside the Apiary and let the colony work. Each cycle produces one of three outputs: §bHoneycomb§f (35%), §bWaxcomb§f (35%), or §bBee Grub§f (30%). The queen takes §e1 damage per cycle§f and is consumed after §e36 cycles§f, so keep buying replacements from the §bMarket§f.

Base cycle is §e3,500 ticks§f (~2.9 min). Each flower, crop, or garden block within a 2-block radius reduces cycle time by §e15%§f. Surround it with flowers for maximum speed.

Press combs in the §bPresser§f: Honeycomb becomes §b2 Honey§f + Grain Bait. Waxcomb becomes §b2 Beeswax§f + Grain Bait.

Craft with §e6 planks§f, §e3 iron§f, §e2 copper§f, and §e1 honeycomb§f.

§ePS:§f Set up multiple apiaries in a flower garden to scale honey and wax production for downstream processing.
